# Ein Sof Captions — Phase Three: Final File Revelation

The Awtsmoos is infinite yet never cluttered, hidden yet never gone;
Awtsmoos.com should let advanced power unfold by choice, then quietly move on.

## Final critique of earlier plans

The first pass risked making “retractable” mean merely wrapping the old control wall in a drawer. That is not enough. The final design must change information hierarchy, interaction semantics, motion intensity, mobile ordering, and architecture at the same time while preserving every renderer parameter and storage key.

## Final improvements

1. Make preview the first visual priority in DOM reading order after the compact top bar.
2. Keep only caption text/header and Generate visibly immediate.
3. Use native `<details>` for advanced groups instead of custom disclosure code.
4. Default advanced groups closed; keep Essentials open.
5. Give each disclosure a short human subtitle so Kabbalistic names remain evocative without obscuring purpose.
6. Replace every randomize emoji span with an actual `button` carrying `aria-pressed`.
7. Randomization ranges appear only while pressed.
8. Persist randomization state under the exact existing `<control>_randomize_active` keys.
9. Persist only known controls from an explicit manifest rather than every id in the document.
10. Keep the same IndexedDB database/store/version.
11. Keep renderer settings names exactly compatible with the old worker.
12. Module Worker replaces inline blob Worker.
13. Preserve 1080×1920 internal render resolution.
14. Preview scales responsively by aspect ratio and never drives document width.
15. Desktop control rail retracts to a compact 58px edge.
16. Mobile control rail becomes an off-canvas sheet with backdrop.
17. Generate action remains reachable at the bottom through a sticky action shelf inside the rail.
18. No continuously pulsing/flickering chrome.
19. Use only short <=180ms opacity/translate transitions.
20. Honor reduced motion.
21. Keep status visible via `aria-live` and a stable overlay/chip.
22. Show batch progress as calm text from worker messages.
23. Disable Generate only during a real render job.
24. Directory picker only appears when supported.
25. Directory cancellation returns UI to ready state without fake error drama.
26. Keep download fallback and filename contract.
27. Keep B\"H and ב\"ה corner marks after post-processing.
28. Keep cosmic background, hero stars, nebulae, meteors, particles, networks, bloom, text box, grain/vignette/chromatic aberration.
29. Rewrite compressed helper functions into readable multiline modules.
30. Keep every new source file <=120 lines without reducing documentation.

## Implementation order

Write the whole shell and CSS first; then main-thread modules; then worker modules; then test. No source verification before the code pass is complete except confirming writes landed. After implementation: line-count gate, syntax gate, module import gate, browser geometry, drawer/disclosures/randomization, storage smoke, and low-density worker render smoke.
